name: agent-architecture-audit
title: agent-architecture-audit
description: A 12-layer diagnostic stack for LLM apps — system prompt, session history, long-term memory, tool layer and more — hunting wrapper regression, memory pollution and hidden repair loops, with severity-ranked code-first fixes.
why: Nothing else in the collection diagnoses a misbehaving agent product layer by layer; directly applicable to the owner's bot checkups, where the same model works in a playground and breaks inside the bot.
